title: Chicken, mushroom and butter bean stew

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple; chicken stock, butter beans, crème fraîche and Dijon mustard are all acceptable cupboard items.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and a knife and board, with simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, 400ml stock with drained beans gives a proper stew, chicken chunks are cooked through after 15 minutes' simmering, and the crème fraîche and mustard season the sauce.

honest_times.reason: The step timings add up to 31 minutes on the hob against 25 printed, and 15 minutes of prep cannot cover chopping 8 thighs, 2 leeks, 400g mushrooms, garlic and kale plus 11 minutes of hands-on browning and frying.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the fresh thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming chicken, leek, kale and mushroom stew suits mid-January, and 400g of mushrooms makes them a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family meal of chicken, beans and three vegetables.
